description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the Oracle JDBC data source, JPA dialect, SQL syntax, and schema definitions to Azure Database for PostgreSQL.
tasks.reason: Replace Oracle Database with Azure Database for PostgreSQL, enabling a fully managed, cloud-native relational database service.
tasks.requirements: Replace the Oracle JDBC driver with the PostgreSQL driver. Update Spring datasource configuration and Hibernate dialect. Convert Oracle-specific SQL in repositories to PostgreSQL-compatible equivalents, including BLOB storage (Oracle BLOB to PostgreSQL bytea).
